Tagged systemd passed 15 required events, comprising 2 parents and 13 leaves, under zero capabilities/NNP for test execution; systemd cleanup and canonical root absence were confirmed. Goldens generation/diff/status succeeded. Go/TypeScript interop passed 27 tests.

## Skips and separate counterpart scopes

The full unit run passed 19609, failed 0 and skipped 1532 across 928 files (877 passed/51 skipped files). The 120 skipped-file summaries below account for every exported unit skip. The 118 baseline skipped-file counts are unchanged (1521 skips). Two new opt-in files add 11 skips: native PostgreSQL/MinIO transport 6 and stock MySQL CLI TLS 5. They require explicitly supplied real fixtures; separate root-local executions do not change this CI unit result. Existing MySQL engine file grew from 8 to 10 total tests, with its original 1 skip unchanged.

The standard log exports per-file counts, not raw assertion-level skip identities or a validated expected-skips sidecar. A passing dedicated group in the same file does not establish that every skipped unit leaf was executed.

Platform PostgreSQL passed 3034/0/8 and all 1124 required groups. Current source defines the eight memory/PGlite backend-inapplicable skips in `tests/runners/late-effect-receipts.test.ts`: memory rollback, immutable-receipt SQL-boundary and blocked-writer cases for both runner/machine, plus PGlite blocked-writer cases for both. These map to six distinct mandatory PostgreSQL counterparts, all passed in the fresh artifact; original memory/PGlite leaves remain inapplicable. The artifact exports the aggregate eight skips, not their raw individual identities.

OpenTofu passed 3916/0/18 and all 27 required groups. The held log places all 18 skips in `tests/tofu/plan-artifact-handoff.test.ts`, whose owning PostgreSQL fixture is absent from the Tofu-only lane. All 18 current literal PostgreSQL handoff requirements passed separately in the fresh platform artifact. These are separate lane results, not a waiver or a count subtraction.

The guest race allowlist contains `TestRealSystemctlAndJournalctl`, `TestRealOpenTofuPlanShowApply`, and `TestRealOpenTofuWithProviderAndLockfile`. The first has a fresh independent 1/0/0 native journal counterpart; the two OpenTofu names were selected by the successful fresh Tofu job step with enabling binary/network declarations, but individual Go JSON events were not exported. The race count remains 3 skips. Hosted contracts retain 13 skips; hosted real-browser 24 checks and agent real-browser 44 checks are separate controlled journeys.
